title: Your story, sharpened.
subtitle: Editing that keeps your voice and makes every page earn its place.
caption:
A great book is rarely written. It's rewritten.

Our editors work with you on the big picture (structure, pacing, character) and the fine detail (sentence flow, clarity, consistency), without losing the voice that makes the story yours.

Tell us about your manuscript and we'll suggest the right level of edit.
short: Your story, sharpened. Developmental, line and copyediting that keeps your voice intact. Tell us about your manuscript.

title: Catch it before your readers do.
subtitle: A final, careful pass so typos never pull readers out of your story.
caption:
One typo on page one can cost you a reader.

Proofreading is the last line of defence before publication: a careful read for spelling, grammar, punctuation and consistency, so your readers stay lost in the story, not in the errors.

Message us to book your proofread.
short: One typo on page one can cost you a reader. Book a final proofread before you publish.

title: 3 signs your manuscript is ready for an editor
points: You've finished the full draft, ending included.
You've revised it yourself at least once.
You can sum up the book in two sentences.
caption:
Not sure if it's time to hire an editor? Here are three signs you're ready:

1. The full draft is finished, ending included.
2. You've done at least one revision pass yourself.
3. You can sum up your book in two sentences.

Ticked all three? Let's talk. Save this post for later.
short: 3 signs your manuscript is ready for an editor: 1) the draft is finished, 2) you've revised it once yourself, 3) you can sum it up in two sentences.

title: Readers do judge a book by its cover.
subtitle: Covers designed to stand out on a shelf and a thumbnail screen.
caption:
Readers really do judge a book by its cover, and they decide in seconds.

We design covers that fit your genre, read clearly as a tiny online thumbnail, and look great on the shelf, from ebook fronts to full print wraps with spine and back cover.

Ready to give your book the cover it deserves?
short: Readers judge a book by its cover in seconds. We design ebook covers and full print wraps that fit your genre.

quote: There is no greater agony than bearing an untold story inside you.
author: Maya Angelou
source: I Know Why the Caged Bird Sings
caption:
"There is no greater agony than bearing an untold story inside you." (Maya Angelou)

What's the story you've been carrying? Tell us in the comments.
short: "There is no greater agony than bearing an untold story inside you." (Maya Angelou) What's the story you've been carrying?

title: Print-ready. Ebook-ready.
subtitle: Professional interior layout that reads beautifully on paper and on screen.
caption:
The inside of your book matters as much as the outside.

We typeset print interiors and prepare ebook files, with clean chapter openers, consistent spacing and properly set front and back matter, so your book is ready to upload.

Get in touch for formatting.
short: Print interiors and ebook files, professionally formatted and ready to upload. Get in touch for formatting.
